tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i mi phyugs glud rabs bzhugs so//

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i mi phyugs gang yin gyi glud la/ zan la nad pa'i gzugs bcos la skra dang gos btum/ ze mjug gi spu rnams kyis legs par brgyan/ glud de'i phyogs bzhir shar du rgyal po/ lho ru gshin rje/ nub tu btsan/ byang du ma mo rnams kyi gzugs dang*/ glud bzhi theb kyu brgyad/ spro na nam rgyang sogs dar sna gos sna zas sna sogs bshams la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod rin po che las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du phung khams skye mched thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gzugs mdzes shing ngag snyan pa/ yid dwangs shing 'dod yon mkho dgu'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pas gnod byed 'byung po'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad tshim zhing dgyes pa bskyed par gyur/ sngags drug phyag drug brjod/ de nas spos dkar dang dkar bsur dmar bsur btang la/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ 'jam dpal sku/ padma gsung*/ yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yonatan/ phur pa phrin las/ ma mo rbod gtong*/ rig 'dzin slob dpon/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ dmod pa drag sngags/ 'tshi med tshe'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthu la brten nas/ 'jig rten khams kyi snang srid lha srin sde brgyad thams cad 'dir 'dus la rta 'di sogs kha bsgyur/mi 'di'i glud gtor dam pa 'di longs shig /glud gtor 'di longs la mi 'di'i lan chags dang bu lon thams cad khyer nas nad pa'i lus ngag yid gsum nad gdon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'di'i 'khyer la/

mi 'di gdon bgegs las thar bar gyur cig /lan gsum brjod/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog dmar skya lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa ras bal rlung gis gtor ba lta bu stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par spros te gnod byed gdon bgegs kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad mdun du bkug par gyur/ hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs las sprul pa'i khro bo ni// ḍā ki zhes bya byung nas ni/ bgegs tshogs 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig /nam mkha' stong pa 'gugs byed na// gzugs su snang ba smos ci dgos// bem po'i rdo yang 'gugs byed na// rnam shes gzhan la smos ci dgos// khug cig drongs shig khro rgyal ḍā ki hūm̐// zhes 'gugs nas de rnams kyi gdug sems zhi bar bsams te/ hūm̐/ zhe sdang gdug pa'i sems rnams zhi bar gyis// snying rje byams pa'i sems su da byon la// dga' mgu rangs pa'i sems kyis gtor ma longs// zhi ba byang chub sems dang ldan par mdzod// zhes brjod gdug pa'i sems zhi nas 'dod yon rnams la longs spyod nas/ de rnams kyi mig gi yul du gzugs mdzes pa/ rna ba'i yul du sgra snyan pa/ sna'i yul du dri zhim pa/ lce'i yul du ro mngar ba/ lus kyi yul du reg bya 'jam pa/ yid kyi yul du bde ba skyed pa/ gzhan yang bza' ba dang btung ba mal cha dang na ba'i gsos sman la sogs rang rang gi yid la gang 'dod pa'i longs spyod kyis tshim par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐/ mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas te tshar bdun re brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan bzhi brjod/ hūm̐/ ya manta ka man chad nas// gshin rje gshed po yan chad kyi// gshin rje'i rigs gyur thams cad la// glud gtor gtsang ma 'di 'bul gyis// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig /hūm̐/ rgyal po dpe har man chad nas// rgyal phran phra mo yan chad kyi// rgyal po'i rigs gyur thams cad la// glud gtor gtsang ma 'di 'bul gyis// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig

/hūm̐/ btsan rgod chen po man chad nas// lung btsan phra mo yan chad kyi// btsan gyi rigs gyur thams cad la// glud gtor gtsang ma 'di 'bul gyis// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig /hūm̐/ bdud chen nag po man chad nas// bdud phran phra mo yan chad kyi// bdud kyi rigs gyur thams cad la// glud gtor gtsang ma 'di 'bul gyis// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig /hūm̐/ rdo rje legs pa man chad nas// 'gong po phra mo yan chad kyi// 'gong po'i rigs gyur thams cad la// glud gtor gtsang ma 'di 'bul gyis// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig /hūm̐/ gza' chen rā hu man chad nas// gza' phran phra mo yan chad kyi// gza' yi rigs gyur thams cad la// glud gtor gtsang ma 'di 'bul gyis// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig /hūm̐/ lha mo brtan ma man chad nas// brtan ma bcu gnyis yan chad kyi// brtan ma'i rigs gyur thams cad la// glud gtor gtsang ma 'di 'bul gyis// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig /hūm̐/ bgegs chen brgyad cu man chad nas// mkha' la rgyu ba yan chad kyi// bgegs tshogs 'byung po thams cad la// glud gtor gtsang ma 'di 'bul gyis// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig /hūm̐/ gri bo gri mo man chad nas// shi 'dre gson 'dre yan chad kyi// 'dre yi rigs gyur thams cad la// glud gtor gtsang ma 'di 'bul gyis// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig /ces pa'i bar gang mang bya'o/ hūm̐/ bsngo'o gtong ngo glud 'di gtong*// mi 'di lus ngag yid gsum gyi// nad gdon ma lus zhi gyur cig /mi las dga' ba'i glud gtor 'di// bka' sdod dam can man chad nas// 'dre ngan phra mo yan chad kyi// che 'bring chung gsum thams cad la// nad pa'i tshabs su glud 'di bsngo// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig /hūm̐// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// padma'i bka' las ma 'da' bar// khyed rnams glud 'di'i tshim gyur nas// mi 'di nad las grol gyur cig

/de nas 'byung bzhi glud gtong bar 'dod na/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba dang po rus pa'i glud// rus pa'i glud 'di rdo la gtong*// rdo la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor dang gnod pa ma byed cig /sha yi glud 'di sa la gtong*// sa la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor dang gnod pa ma byed cig /khrag gi glud 'di chu la gtong*// chu la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor dang gnod pa ma byed cig /drod kyi glud 'di me la gtong*// me la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor dang gnod pa ma byed cig /dbugs kyi glud 'di rlung la gtong*// rlung la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor dang gnod pa ma byed cig /sems kyi glud 'di mkha' la gtong*// mkha' la gnas pa'i lha 'dre rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor dang gnod pa ma byed cig /phyi ltar bltas na dri sman lnga// nang ltar bltas na rin chen lnga// gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// 'khor gnod ma byed rang gnas song*// 'di 'dra'i glud mchog ya mtshan can// zer mo'i skra la zho sha'i snying*// sgron bu'i so la lung thang mig /lag pa g.yas pa rin chen gser// lag pa g.yon pa rin chen g.yu// phyag gi gar stabs lings se ling*// rkang pa g.yas pa thabs kyi lcags// rkang pa g.yon pa shes rab zangs// zhabs kyi bro brdung khrigs se khrig /bcos bcos de ni brgyan brgyan nas// skyes pa dmag la chas pa 'dra// skyes pa pho yi glud du khyod gtong ngo*// za ma gser g.yu'i rgyan dang bcas// byis pa 'di nas ngar ngar nas// mo btsun bag mar chas pa 'dra// za ma mo'i glud du khyod gtong ngo*// byis pa chung ngu'i glud du khyod gtong ngo*// mnyam mnyam mda' sgro glud du khyod gtong ngo*// bon bon gser gser glud du khyod gtong ngo*// che ba rgyal po'i glud du khyod gtong ngo*// ngan long sprang po'i glud du khyod gtong ngo*// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi glud du khyod gtong ngo*// glud bdag rnams kyis glud 'di longs// yas bdag rnams kyis yas 'di longs// mas bdag rnams kyis mas 'di longs// shar du dkar po'i phyag tu 'bul// lho ru ser po'i phyag tu 'bul// nub tu dmar po'i phyag tu 'bul// byang du ljang gu'i phyag tu 'bul// gnam du 'khor lo'i phyag tu 'bul// zhi ba lha yi phyag tu 'bul// bka' gnyan rgyal pa'i phyag tu 'bul// 'gyogs pa btsan gyi phyag tu 'bul// nag po bdud kyi phyag tu 'bul// gdug pa klu yi phyag tu 'bul// srog bdag dbugs len phyag tu 'bul// 'dre lnga bdud bcos phyag tu 'bul/

nam mkha' gang ba'i lha 'dre la// ri rab tsam gyi gtor glud 'bul// 'bul ba bdag gis ma nor ro// bzhes pa khyed kyis ma 'khrul cig /da ni gshegs so sha ra ra// da ni bzhud do si li li// do nub rnal 'byor 'di ru sdod// mi shong tsam gyi rta mi shong*// rta shong tsam gyis sga mi shong*// khyi phag 'di ni tshang mi gcig /bya byi de ni gnas mi gcig /'di ru 'dug pa'i gnas tshol rnams// glud dang gtor ma 'di longs la// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// sho la bab na sho rdel stor// rgyan la bab na rgyan de spos// rtsis la babasan rtsis de phyung*// khram la babs na khram kha chings// na ba'i na bun thon la song*// tsha ba'i tsha bun thon la song*// sdam pa lhod la bcings pa khrol// bdud kyi zhags pa da khrol cig /lha gnyan gangs dkar rtse la gshegs// klu gnyan rgya mtsho'i gting la gshegs// rgyal po dkor khang nang du gshegs// btsan rgod brag dmar logs la gshegs// the'u rang brag phug stong par gshegs// 'byung po rol rol nang du gshegs// bal mo brgya lam nang du gshegs// rang rang so so'i gnas su song*// de nas sgrub bya rnams la glud rnams bskor/ khro bo hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas la/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas deng bsgrub bya de rnams steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ 'og gdon sa bdag klu gnyan/ bar gdon btsan dang rgyal po la sogs pa 'byung po mi ma yin gyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad mchod sbyin glud gtor bzang po 'di khyer la so so rang rang gnas su bde bar dengs shig

/gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba 'di rnams kyis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs drag sngags brjod cing gnam lcags kyi bab glud gtor rnams phyi rol du gnod phyogs su bskyal phyi mig mi lta bar log /bka' bsgo ni/ bka' bsgo 'di yi nus mthu yis// thal phye rlung gis gtor ba bzhin// gnod byed 'di ru gnas mi 'gyur// drang srong dmod pa zlog tu mnan// bsrung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rdo rje'i mtshon cha dpag tu med pa 'phros pas steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i rtsig pa dang rwa ba'i gtams pa'i phyi rol ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bar gnod byed thams cad bsreg par gyur/ khyad par du yang bsgrub bya 'di nyid lus rdo rje'i go khrab kyis zhu lubs su g.yogs pas bar chad gdon bgegs rnams kyis cis kyang mi tshugs par bsgom/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i byin rlabs kyis// 'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrung byin gyi// 'di la sus kyang gnod pa ma byed cig /sogs yi dam gang byed kyi tshig bsgyur/ zhes bsngo smon bkra shis sogs mthar brgyan bya/ zhes sprul sku bstan gnyis gling pa la zam lung khyung tshang du gu rus gdams pa'o/// /
